title: The Best Beginner Country Two Step Dance Moves!

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructors teach as a pair with an energetic, clear, and methodical breakdown of country two-step fundamentals. They divide explanations into leader and follower perspectives with structured step-by-step guidance.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of instructors and the dance style.
Breakdown of the basic steps, timing, and frame for leaders.
Breakdown of framing and holds for both leaders and followers.
Introduction and breakdown of the promenade position.
Breakdown of the first half of the couples turn.

safety: Swing your leg back so you don't get stepped on

steps_taught.name: Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Four walking steps in quick-quick-slow-slow rhythm.

steps_taught.name: Promenade
steps_taught.description: Traveling variation in frame on a diagonal.

what_works: Separating leader and follower instructions clearly
Demonstrating timing with both count names and physical steps
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between technical alignment terms without immediate floor drill

quotes.text: The rhythm or timing of basic two step is quick-quick-slow-slow.
I call this towel on a towel bar.

evidence_segments.observation: Leader demonstrates basic footwork alone facing forward.
Instructors demonstrate hand placement for the couple's frame.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using visual imagery like the 'towel bar' to explain arm height and spatial framing.
